    The Auslander–Reiten translate and the Auslander–Reiten formula #

    For a free presentation Aⁿ¹ → Aⁿ⁰ → Z → 0 with matrix F, the translate is τ_P Z = ker ν F, where ν F : DAⁿ¹ → DAⁿ⁰ is the Nakayama transform. For every module W, Hom_A(W, τ_P Z) ≅ D(Wⁿ¹ / F Wⁿ⁰) (homTauEquiv), via the Nakayama isomorphism θ. When the presentation is a projective resolution (Aⁿ¹ → Aⁿ⁰ injective), Wⁿ¹ / F Wⁿ⁰ is Ext¹(Z, W), so this is the Auslander–Reiten formula D Ext¹(Z, W) ≅ Hom(W, τZ) for pd Z ≤ 1.
